t: The Hartz Mountain Corporation - Company Profile, Information, Business Description, History, Background Information on The Hartz Mountain Corporation
s: The product of a German immigrant's struggle to survive in a new country, Hartz Mountain Corp. was started in 1926 as a dealer in canaries, then grew to dominate the American pet supply industry. By the 1990s, Hartz Mountain no longer sold canaries imported from the Hartz Mountain region in Germany, but sold nearly everything else a pet owner could desire.
